dxmd<7:0>.function: DQ pads, bidirectional DDR data: write data in (to the Rx slices), read data out (from the Tx slices)

a2djg.function: DQS pad, bidirectional strobe: write strobe in (center-aligned, both edges sample DQ); driven as read strobe (from RE) by the Tx

kd9h.function: DQSB pad, complementary bidirectional strobe (replaced by VREF in SE DQS mode; driven as ~DQS on reads)

iu7a.function: RE read-enable pad (true phase); read clock from which DQ/DQS outputs and z6y7x are timed

ydj9.function: nRE pad (complement); replaced by VREF when hpaa=1

aed2r.function: ZQ pad to external precision RZQ (300 ohm to VSSQ); PU replica legs drive it during calibration

d53w.function: external VREFQ pad for DQ receivers / SE strobes (used when oaov36=0)

erflz2<31:0>.function: deserialized write data to the core, erflz2<4n+3:4n> = DQ<n> UI3..UI0, updated once per DQS/2 word

bodg.function: DQS/2 word clock to the core (buffered xquh); core captures erflz2 on its rising edge

j9y56<7:0>.function: even read data per DQ from the core (sent while the RE-derived clock is high)

o83e<7:0>.function: odd read data per DQ from the core (sent while the RE-derived clock is low)

z6y7x.function: RE-derived clock to the core read pipeline (launches j9y56/o83e and ae1v)

afvfm.function: Rx enable: DQ/DQS receivers and strobe distribution (power-down when 0)

hhqjm.function: Rx path select: 0 = matched (DQ replica delay + DQS H-tree), 1 = unmatched (DQ direct + DQS repeater chain)

p4xy.function: 1 = single-ended DQS (DQS vs VREF), 0 = differential DQS/DQSB

oaov36.function: 1 = internal VREF DAC, 0 = d53w; also powers the ladder/OTA

jsfy<4:0>.function: internal VREF tap, ~34.5%..71.4% of VCCQ in ~1.2% steps

jc9f4p<2:0>.function: Rx DQS delay trim on both strobe phases

cu2af5<23:0>.function: per-bit Rx DQ deskew, cu2af5<3n+2:3n> for DQ<n> (training, mainly unmatched mode)

wcu58e.function: active-low reset of the DQS/2 divider; release sets the deser word alignment

yemsy.function: test mode: observe xquh on f84c0z

f84c0z.function: test observation output (xquh gated by yemsy & afvfm)

fv9mp.function: DQ output enable; 0 = all DQ driver legs off (Hi-Z); 1 also forces DQ ODT off

lxv2s.function: DQS/DQSB output enable (preamble..postamble); 1 also forces DQS ODT off

ae1v.function: 1 = DQS/DQSB toggle with RE, 0 = DQS low / DQSB high (preamble/postamble)

e9k4l<1:0>.function: output slew rate: pre-driver starving current

a46hb.function: on-die termination enable (writes); auto-gated off per group by fv9mp/lxv2s

yo1i<2:0>.function: ODT strength: ~300/150/100/75/60/50/43 ohm Thevenin for codes 1..7

tvxkez.function: slow calibration clock (~10 MHz, core oscillator): ZQ SAR/counter and DCC comparator/counter; not a high-speed clock

k0qtd.function: ZQ calibration enable: VREF divider, comparators, replica legs, PD tracking

d4ih7z.function: ZQ calibration start pulse (tvxkez domain): starts the PU SAR

wzymw4.function: ZQ reset: SAR code 0, PD counter mid-scale

wbjp.function: PU SAR finished (also enables PD tracking)

mu0x<4:0>.function: calibrated pull-up code (readback); internally drives the DQ/DQS PU leg enables

yxapm<4:0>.function: calibrated pull-down code (readback); internally drives the DQ/DQS PD leg enables

ww3p.function: 1 = driver strength from ymob/u09t92 instead of ZQ codes

ps7xf1.function: DCC training command: 1 = run the duty-cycle loop while RE toggles; 0 = hold the code, clear lock

wvk9mh.function: DCC loop locked (two dither events); also freezes the code

jmfj<4:0>.function: current DCC code readback (offset binary, 10000 neutral)

e92if2.function: ~10 uA reference current from the bandgap; mirrored to ZQ comparators and the VREF buffer

vdd.function: core supply (~1.0 V): Rx back end, clock trees, serializer/deser, calibration logic

vccq.function: IO supply (1.2 V): receivers, level shifters, pre-drivers, drivers, ODT, ESD, ZQ analog, VREF

qp91a5.role: Enable/mode control: level-shifts ikliqn, djfa and internal-VREF select to VCCQ, decodes mj8kv into mux selects and strobe clock-gate enables, test observe enable

children.role: djfa -> a3si7p/xegk (VCCQ) for DQS input TG select

qp91a5.notes: Static control decode; all outputs are quasi-static mode signals.

a44p.role: Internal VREFQ generator: enable PMOS + 32-tap resistor ladder on VCCQ, 5-bit TG tree mux, unity-gain OTA buffer, external/internal select mux, VREF decap

children.role: gcyl vs buffered internal VREF select

controls.horj<4:0>: selects ladder tap pa6c<code>; pa6c<0>=14.5k/42k (~34.5% VCCQ), pa6c<31> ~71.4% VCCQ, 500 ohm/step (~1.2%)
controls.n1tzk: 1: internal VREF (ladder on via Mn5yvw, OTA enabled, Xnrq6jn passes aejl); 0: gcyl passed, ladder and OTA off

a44p.notes: Ladder: Ron77 12k (top) + Rw31p<30:0> 31 x 500 ohm + Ri9di 14.5k (bottom), ~29 uA from VCCQ when on. OTA in unity-gain feedback (opjbuu = g5k3l). Cbg9z 2p and MOS cap Mf0ow decouple sj8uy. Static bias; not on the high-speed path. In udmp gcyl arrives through the VREF pad cell (Xsuj0kt ye8xk0).

vv7jcn.role: 32:1 binary-tree analog TG mux (thick-ox, VCCQ) for VREF tap selection

controls.h9j9qr<4:0>: binary tap index (h9j9qr<0> = LSB at the leaf level); l4lpzy<4:0> are the complements

vv7jcn.notes: Each level halves the candidates; odd taps on g94lcx, even taps on axz6m. Static.

fgjco.role: Two-stage Miller OTA (NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS second stage), thick-ox on VCCQ, with power-down; used as unity-gain VREF buffer

controls.ymovk: enable (Mz2n1 pulls w9rzz to VCCQ when ymovk=0)
controls.r5jy: power-down (Mqszi grounds bias gate when r5jy=1)

fgjco.notes: Mbh07 diode sets tail (Macfm) and 2nd-stage sink (Mjxevhe) currents; Rbkfiuz 5k + Cvzljq 0.8p nulling-resistor Miller compensation.

un713b.role: Strobe receive path: DQS/DQSB input TGs with diff/SE select, two complementary receivers (true and complement strobe), VCCQ->VDD level conversion, DQS delay trim, clock gating, matched H-trees and unmatched RPT chains for both strobe phases

children.role: always-on TG on DQS (matches the select TG on the ref side and the DQ input TG)
passes DQSB to qtdhx in differential mode
passes VREF to qtdhx in single-ended mode
complement-strobe receiver (ref minus DQS), inputs swapped
true strobe gate into matched tree (jhzo)
complement strobe gate into matched tree (jhzo)
true strobe gate into RPT chain (wap5kq)
complement strobe gate into RPT chain (wap5kq)
unmatched RPT chain, true strobe -> wkqkft<8:0>
unmatched RPT chain, complement strobe -> vgvk6<8:0>

controls.wqm5q1: 1: VREF drives qtdhx (single-ended DQS); s8ql is its complement (1: DQSB drives qtdhx)
controls.lgp56p<2:0>: strobe trim delay, same code on both phases

un713b.notes: Complement strobe is made by a second identical receiver with swapped inputs (not an inverter) so rise/fall sampling clocks have matched latency; in SE mode the complement receiver compares VREF vs DQS. Xo1nhy is an intentionally always-on TG (qpkdub tied vccq, rbsi8 tied vssq) matching Xbyvi/Xqd2e and the DQ-slice input TG. Only one distribution network toggles at a time. In udmp o9g8/yly3 come from the pksyp outputs of the two jq2jj pad cells (same fwhwl as DQ), so the DQS input sees the same pad loading as DQ.

we5v.role: Per-DQ receive slice: input TG, VREF-referenced receiver, VCCQ->VDD conversion, per-bit deskew, matched replica delay, mode muxes for data and both strobe phases, rise/fall DDR samplers, 1:4 deserializer (instantiated in c4ar97)

children.role: always-on input TG, matches the DQS input TG
replica of DQS clock gate + H-tree delay (matched mode)
rise strobe select: H-tree leaf (w73d59) vs RPT tap (s2jpi)
fall strobe select: H-tree leaf (w73d59) vs RPT tap (s2jpi)

controls.zdjooo: 0 = matched (replica data + H-tree strobes), 1 = unmatched (direct data + RPT taps); qm5cj is its complement and also gates the replica

we5v.notes: Matched path is a structural copy of the strobe path: same TG, receiver, zmf6 and ismh cells, then xbcz59 (uye5vz + 3 yydl) replicating uye5vz + root/branch/leaf of wggy, and the same kr7x cell on data and strobe. In unmatched mode the replica is bypassed and clock-gated. Fall sampler clock z7dl8 also retimes the rise sample inside the deser. In udmp the bqc6 input is the secondary-protected pad node gh1dv of the shared bidirectional pad cell (c4ar97/Xal7gi), so the DQ Tx driver and ODT legs load the same pad.

xbcz59.role: DQ replica delay line matching DQS clock gate + 3-level H-tree (gate, root, branch, leaf yydl with lumped replica load caps)

children.role: replica of the DQS-path clock gate (pay7 = qm5cj)

controls.pay7: gates the replica off in unmatched mode (power)

xbcz59.notes: Cvz07s9 17f / Cpa0b14 13f emulate fan-out-3 (two extra yydl inputs + wire) seen by the real root/branch; Csd7h2m 5f equals the tree leaf wire cap.

wggy.role: Matched DQS distribution: 1->3->9 buffered H-tree of yydl with lumped wire caps; leaves 0..7 to DQ slices, leaf 8 to the divider slice
wggy.notes: Equal depth (3 yydl) and equal fan-out to every leaf; replicated on the DQ side by xbcz59.

ax7dv.role: Unmatched DQS distribution: 9 repeaters (q8t9) with pi-RC wire segments; the tap after each repeater drives one slice directly
ax7dv.notes: Latency increases monotonically from y39jdi<0> to y39jdi<8>; no DQ-side replica, so per-bit DQ deskew/training absorbs the skew in unmatched mode.

bxgg.role: DDR sampler pair: rise-edge sampler on ukw8, fall-edge sampler on p4rq (complement strobe)

u0vlr.role: StrongARM sense-amp flip-flop: always-on TG + inverter make delay-matched d/db, StrongARM latch (lvt), NAND SR latch
u0vlr.notes: Evaluates on o8w9v rising, precharges (Mdzm9/Mcf343t/Mnwbui/Majpvvd) while o8w9v low; pmvw falls when lutju3=1, so a47gj8=1. The Muvyh0/Mauja TG intentionally matches the inverter delay of the db side. SR latch holds during precharge.

xeip.role: Deser clock slice: mode mux for strobe leaf/tap 8, divide-by-2 toggle flop, k1rmky/lpksua buffers, jjezn driver to core

children.role: matched/unmatched strobe select (same cell as bit slices)

controls.rwbe: selects leaf 8 of the H-tree or tap 8 of the RPT chain
controls.jxah5g: divider reset (rzaf=0: k1rmky low, lpksua high)

xeip.notes: Divide-by-2 feedback loop qz5196 -> u79k. lpksua is derived from qz5196, one inverter later than rzaf, which is tolerated because the deser capture window is one full DQS period. jjezn is exported as bodg at udmp.

j19e.role: Test observation gate/driver for the deser clock

ismh.role: 3-bit binary cap-load delay trim: two lvt inverters with 1x/2x/4x switched MOS-cap loads on the middle node

controls.p59e<2:0>: switches Ma7yi/Mkxuc/Ms71d3 MOS caps (m=1/2/4) onto qzjk; larger p59e = more delay

ismh.notes: Used in both DQ (e1eb) and DQS (lgp56p) paths so the code-0 delay matches.

kr7x.role: NAND-NAND 2:1 mux, gwfbl = q1ghmr ? s2jpi : w73d59; same cell on data and strobe paths for delay matching
kr7x.notes: Two-level NAND path is identical for w73d59 and s2jpi.

vmgkr.role: Bazes complementary self-biased differential receiver (thick-ox, VCCQ) with power-down

controls.pto2s: enables NMOS tail (Mook2) and releases rwmoqj
controls.wove: enables PMOS tail (Mjpqt78); when high, Mv644b clamps lweqg low

vmgkr.notes: rwmoqj is the self-bias feedback node driving both tail devices; lweqg is non-inverting w.r.t. xr7h and not full-swing (squared by edau8i). Used for DQ (rjct=VREF) and for both DQS phases (swapped inputs).

q8m8.role: Thick-oxide transmission gate on VCCQ (input select / delay matching)
q8m8.notes: Instances with qpkdub tied to vccq / rbsi8 to vssq are permanently on (matching elements).

edau8i.role: VCCQ->VDD down level converter: VCCQ inverter then thick-gate inverter on VDD
edau8i.notes: First stage squares the receiver output to full VCCQ swing; second stage uses hv devices so its gate tolerates VCCQ.

ptto.role: Thick-oxide TG 2:1 analog mux on VCCQ, h5q1 = o83wq ? g94lcx : axz6m

q8t9.role: Two-stage lvt repeater for long strobe/clock wires

ciz0t2.role: RE/nRE input receiver: input TGs with diff/SE select, Bazes receiver, dummy complementary receiver for input-load symmetry, VCCQ->VDD conversion

children.role: always-on TG on RE (matches the select TGs)
passes nRE to rg3xy in differential mode
passes VREF to rg3xy in single-ended mode
dummy receiver with swapped inputs, output unused (load balance)

controls.wbac: 1: VREF is the reference (SE RE); g8jthl: 1: nRE is the reference

ciz0t2.notes: Xwk3u7 output jnrb4 is intentionally unused: it only equalizes the capacitive load presented to RE and nRE. In udmp mkdw1/oi8e are the secondary-protected pad nodes ktu6j/c4vsk and edkvt is the internal/external VREFQ (k8aj95), shared with the DQ receivers.

wtth.role: Duty-cycle adjuster: inverter with code-enabled binary PU/PD auxiliary legs (asymmetric edge strength) + output inverter; offset-binary decode

children.role: PU leg enable decode hna1da<i> = ~(v2qwm<4> & v2qwm<i>)

controls.v2qwm<4:0>: offset binary: v2qwm<4>=1 enables PU legs (m=8/4/2/1 on v2qwm<3:0>) -> faster xghw3p rise -> earlier wyfs90 fall -> lower duty; v2qwm<4>=0 enables PD legs on ~v2qwm<3:0> -> earlier wyfs90 rise -> higher duty; 10000/01111 neutral

wtth.notes: Cnqfv 6f on xghw3p sets the edge rate the legs act on. Intentional rise/fall asymmetry is the adjustment mechanism.

f7hz.role: Global clock repeater (RPT) chain: 4 repeaters with pi-RC wire segments from RE pad area to the byte

h1n10i.role: Slew-rate bias generator: resistor-referenced NMOS mirror, vdm8zj-switched current DAC into PMOS diode (y52pv7), mirrored into NMOS diode (o9b9u4)

controls.vdm8zj<1:0>: adds 1x (bit0) and 2x (bit1) to the base 2x mirror current; higher code -> more pre-driver current -> faster output edges

h1n10i.notes: Always on (no enable). kao3td<1:0> unused. Cgk658/Cryil decouple the bias lines distributed to all slices. Lives in hggq3i; y52pv7/o9b9u4 go to every DQ/DQS pre-driver.

gugmik.role: TX control: level-shifts enables and drive codes to VCCQ, gates PU/PD leg enables with zkl7 / eiu8s, generates DQS/DQSB even/odd patterns from pmv9
gugmik.notes: pu_en_* is active-high (NAND in pre-driver), pd_dis_* is active-high disable (NOR in pre-driver). Unused LS complements: oq0e5, cfn15, xn2l<4:0>, kz82m<4:0>. pmv9 is launched by the core on z6y7x and retimed inside the DQS slices, so its buffering here is not timing-critical. In udmp ga5p/wsx8n come from z0nj9x (ZQ result or override) inside pk25sw.

siyoi.role: Clock phase splitter: 2-inverter true path and TG+inverter complement path with matched delay
siyoi.notes: xfij non-inverted, z1xj inverted; the always-on TG Msh5aj8/Mc41u9l replaces one inverter delay on the z1xj side.

xoa6.role: 2:1 DDR serializer: even and odd retime flops on r86k3 falling (r9nk9 rising), half-cycle latch on the odd path, clocked TG mux and output buffer

children.role: odd half-cycle latch, transparent while r86k3 high

xoa6.notes: r86k3 high selects yo1jrm (even), r86k3 low selects l0lwu (odd). yo1jrm changes at r86k3 fall and is stable while selected; l0lwu changes during r86k3 high and is stable during r86k3 low, so the mux output is glitch-free. One clock cycle of latency.

n26dpi.role: Static TG D-latch, transparent when gi5kb=1

controls.gi5kb: transparent when high (b4fj complement drives keeper TG Mpxs6zy/Mivis)

n26dpi.notes: Half-cycle latch on the odd path of xoa6 (gi5kb = r86k3): holds the odd bit through the r86k3-low phase.

v1zh.role: High-speed VDD->VCCQ cross-coupled level shifter for serialized data (lvt input inverter, hv latch, hv output inverter)
v1zh.notes: Ratioed latch gives unequal rise/fall delay (duty distortion on the data path).

v18jr.role: One pre-driver leg: NAND(data, rhxtq)+inverter+current-starved inverter for the PMOS gate; NOR(data, atea)+inverter+current-starved inverter for the NMOS gate

controls.gea1: PMOS starving bias of the final stages (output slew)
controls.gquo: NMOS starving bias of the final stages (output slew)

v18jr.notes: rq3o = NAND(x8g750, rhxtq), d3v2w = NOR(x8g750, atea); disabled leg gives rq3o=1, d3v2w=0 (Hi-Z). Mf9bd/Mkwep87 and Ml51ko2/Mfexd are the starving devices.

ewiu3i.role: Unit output leg: thick-ox PMOS pull-up + series poly R, thick-ox NMOS pull-down + series poly R
ewiu3i.notes: Series resistors linearize the output impedance.

xz3c.role: Two-stage lvt clock buffer, 2x yydl strength

ajlh.role: Two-stage lvt repeater for long clock wires

uq60.notes: Provides constant odd-phase DQS/DQSB pattern bits.

uqsz.notes: Pre-driver PU gating (iyh7t3 = data) and static code gating.

i6p6kc.role: IO pad ESD cell: GDPMOS to VCCQ and GGNMOS to VSSQ (primary, gate-coupled through 10k), 200 ohm series R and secondary GGNMOS on the receiver side
i6p6kc.notes: Mk3q5 (ycgzf, gate to VCCQ via Rj57v) and Mr33a (jil3gy, gate to VSSQ via Rj26d) are off in normal operation; Mgjykmj is a gate-grounded secondary clamp protecting receiver gate oxide (CDM). Used in fwhwl (DQ, DQS, DQSB) and ye8xk0 (RE, nRE, VREF_EXT); the receivers tap vfryt, the drivers and ODT attach at y3akw4.

texe.role: Primary-only pad ESD (GDPMOS + GGNMOS) for the ZQ pin
texe.notes: ZQ pad (udmp/Xgxymzp): primary clamps only, no series R (calibration accuracy).

so79m.role: RC-triggered active rail clamp: 500k/1p trigger, 3-inverter driver, large thick-ox NMOS clamp (Mbgob)
so79m.notes: Normal operation: v5uxb = yuzoi -> clamp gate low (off). Fast ESD ramp holds v5uxb low for ~0.5 us -> clamp on. Two instances in gja4: VCCQ-VSSQ and VDD-VSS.

epfg.role: Back-to-back diode-connected thick-ox NMOS pair coupling VSS and VSSQ
epfg.notes: Conducts only when the grounds separate by more than a Vt.

ryk2.role: Per-pin termination: 3 binary PU legs (ycgzf + 480/240/120 ohm) to VCCQ and 3 PD legs (jil3gy + R) to VSSQ, center-tapped at the pad
ryk2.notes: Unit leg ~600 ohm each side; Thevenin at VCCQ/2. One per pad cell (fwhwl/Xuuqsg); gates come from kwgk, which forces the legs off while that pin group drives.

vwt2x6.role: ZQ calibration: VCCQ/2 reference, PU replica legs on the ZQ pin vs external RZQ with comparator + 5-bit SAR, PD replica legs against an internal PU copy with comparator + up/down tracking counter, code-to-gate level shifting; codes go to the DQ/DQS driver strength

children.role: PU comparator: VREF vs ZQ pin
PU replica legs driving the ZQ pin
internal PU copy + PD replica legs (node v79w)

controls.weve: powers VREF divider, comparators (via xhhhbx) and enables replica gates

vwt2x6.notes: Two feedback loops. PU: SAR code -> gate driver -> replica PMOS legs into the ZQ pin against external RZQ -> comparator (kdzjl0=1 when ZQ > VREF, i.e. PU too strong) -> SAR clears the trial bit; 5 decisions after start, then wqqd4l. PD: counter code -> gate driver -> PD replica legs against an internal copy of the calibrated PU at v79w -> comparator (kdzjl0=1 when v79w > VREF, PD too weak) -> count up; runs continuously once wqqd4l (dithers +/-1 LSB). r19gn<4:0> and xydzi<4:0> gate-driver outputs are unused; the counter t1ehl9 input is tied to vss. Mjqc0jq is the PMOS diode receiving ici43i, giving the comparator tail bias. In udmp jxzrv is the shared slow calibration clock tvxkez; orzf/ebqty feed pk25sw (z0nj9x -> gugmik -> leg enables of all DQ/DQS drivers) and are also read back as mu0x/yxapm. Replica unit is 1/8 of the driver unit, so the calibrated code gives Rpu = RZQ/8 at the pad (37.5 ohm for RZQ = 300 ohm).

z78y9.role: Switched resistive VCCQ/2 divider with decap

zhq5.role: Static two-stage comparator (PMOS input pair, NMOS mirror, NMOS CS second stage) on VCCQ with enable, plus VCCQ->VDD level shift
zhq5.notes: kdzjl0 = 1 when nj6dtl > beay8 (inverting with respect to beay8). Used with beay8 = VREF.

mlg3h7.role: 5-bit SAR register: one-hot pointer shift register taot5e<5:0>, per-bit set/decide/hold logic, code flops, done flag

children.role: next-code OR of the three terms

mlg3h7.notes: Sequence: taot5e<5> (start) sets ia95r9=10000; during taot5e<i> bit i is on trial and at the end of taot5e<i> it is kept if wmrv=0 (jju5=1) while bit i-1 is set; after taot5e<0> t84nq=1 and the code holds. Feedback: ia95r9<i> -> hold term -> next code. x8qi1<5:0>, kie1<4:0>, xek4 unused.

jw9qyf.role: Code-to-replica-gate driver: VDD->VCCQ level shift, NAND with enable (active-low gate aoqpe), inverter (active-high ppp9)

children.role: ppp9 = p2wx & sso1 for NMOS legs

jw9qyf.notes: l2kk<4:0> unused. Each instance uses only one of ppp9 / aoqpe.

fn5wjn.role: 5-bit synchronous saturating up/down counter (XNOR propagate, AND carry chain, XOR next state), reset to 10000, enable and hold

children.role: sxk8i: counter updates on fm57 falling

fn5wjn.notes: Feedback through fwkdy<4:0> -> XNOR/XOR. Saturates at 11111 (up) and 00000 (down). of41s (bit-4 i0d54c) and ye9xuu<3:0> unused. Shared by DCC and ZQ-PD. Two instances: vwt2x6/Xljla (PD tracking, t1ehl9 tied to vss) and wlyjd/Xhugq (DCC code, t1ehl9 = i7zg).

vui2.role: StrongARM latched comparator with NAND SR latch
vui2.notes: aqhzb8 = 1 when ok1s8r > nuje at the dtkw rising edge. Used as the DCC comparator (wlyjd/Xjfgd), strobed by the gated calibration clock rz2bge.

z1nko.role: Static TG master-slave DFF with active-low lelk8 and i0d54c
z1nko.notes: Bit-4 flop of fn5wjn, so the counter resets to 10000.

d9b5zl.role: Static CMOS XOR2 (12T, internal input inverters)

wfrbt.role: Static CMOS XNOR2 (12T, internal input inverters)

l5tu7.notes: Used inside bj6r/zuhc6m (Rx deser, DQS/2 divider, Tx serializer) and in control/calibration logic.

w4yyx.notes: Static control buffers (qp91a5, gugmik, z0nj9x, j19e).

kfwj.notes: HS inverter: uye5vz, ismh, u0vlr, xoa6 output, n26dpi, wtth output.

yavkxw.notes: On the HS path inside zuhc6m of the DQS/2 divider; elsewhere static/calibration logic.

wxlvj5.notes: On the HS path inside zuhc6m of the DQS/2 divider; elsewhere DCA decode, ODT gating, counters.

yo4ne.notes: uye5vz, kr7x and u0vlr SR latch.

yydl.notes: Rx H-tree, DQ replica delay, divider buffers, Tx tree branches/leaves, DCA input buffer.

uye5vz.notes: Rx strobe gating (matched/unmatched) and the DQ replica gate in xbcz59.

bj6r.role: Static transmission-gate master-slave positive-edge DFF with local clock inverters and keeper loops
bj6r.notes: Rx deserializer flops and Tx serializer even/odd flops.

zuhc6m.role: Static TG master-slave DFF with active-low asynchronous reset (NAND in master, NOR in slave) and qz5196 output
zuhc6m.notes: DQS/2 divider (HS); ZQ SAR, counters and DCC lock detector (not HS).

sprh.role: Static VDD->VCCQ cross-coupled level shifter with true/complement outputs
sprh.notes: Static VDD->VCCQ shifting of enables and codes (qp91a5, gugmik, kwgk, zq, vref, sr bias).

l0sxx.role: 1:4 deserializer per bit: retime the rise sample onto the fall strobe, capture (UI0,UI1) on y3h4vh, re-register them and capture (UI2,UI3) on fj7kaj so all four outputs update together
l0sxx.notes: (woj6, ej5ebo) is valid for one DQS period after each yb1z edge. y3h4vh rise captures UI0/UI1 into jcjxgh/btk1; the next fj7kaj rise (one DQS period later) captures UI2/UI3 and re-registers jcjxgh/btk1, so y07ql<3:0> changes once per word (every 2 DQS periods) and the core can capture it on bodg (= y3h4vh) rising, mid-window. y07ql<0> is the first UI. Burst-to-word alignment depends on the divider reset phase (wcu58e release). Switch-level check: 11 random words reproduced in UI order.

w4tk6.role: Per-pin Tx core slice: local clock phase split, 2:1 DDR serializer, VDD->VCCQ HS level shifter, 5-leg slew-controlled pre-driver; drives the main-driver leg gates e5bxo/bn1xm of the pad cell

children.role: aoar1/owc3 generation from the tree leaf clock
per-leg pre-drivers with enables and slew bias

w4tk6.notes: The main driver legs moved into the pad cell (fwhwl/Xag486n f8zz), so this slice ends at the leg gates: e5bxo<i> low = PU leg on (data 1 & jrf7<i>), bn1xm<i> high = PD leg on (data 0 & ~c79ay<i>). Output has two buses, so inverting is null; data to pad is non-inverting. aoar1 high sends the even bit, aoar1 low the odd bit (switch-level checked). Same cell for DQS/DQSB with constant patterns.

f8zz.role: Main output driver: 5 binary-weighted PU/PD unit legs (x16/x8/x4/x2/x1) to the pad
f8zz.notes: Strength is selected by which leg gates are enabled (ZQ/override code applied in gugmik, pre-driver per leg). Unit leg = ycgzf 8u + 300 ohm, jil3gy 4u + 300 ohm (ZQ replica unit is 1/8 of this). Pad cap now in fwhwl (Ctk4uyq).

i8uv.role: Pre-driver bank: data buffer plus 5 slew-controlled pre-driver legs sized x8/x4/x2/x1/x1 for driver legs x16/x8/x4/x2/x1
i8uv.notes: l89fyg/lmh4 are both low when data is 1 (PMOS on, NMOS off): inverting w.r.t. jzyuz, the pad is not. jj2gv is the twice-buffered (true) jzyuz fanning out to all 5 legs.

unj9o.role: RE clock buffer with the in-path duty-cycle adjuster: yydl -> wtth -> xz3c into the RPT chain

controls.s885oa<4:0>: duty adjust from wlyjd (offset binary, 10000/01111 neutral)

unj9o.notes: No local monitor tap any more: the DCC detector senses the distributed clock at the tree leaf l95t3.

hux9.role: Local Tx clock tree: xz3c root, 2 branches, 10 slice leaves (ne8j3p<7:0> DQ, ne8j3p<8> DQS, ne8j3p<9> DQSB), core-clock tap and the DCC sense leaf
hux9.notes: Each branch drives 6 identical yydl leaves (branch 0: ne8j3p<4:0> + core tap; branch 1: ne8j3p<9:5> + DCC sense leaf), so jq5c has the same latency/duty as the DQS/DQSB leaves it sits next to.

qiex8.role: Duty detector: gated clock and complement drive two matched 2-pole RC low-pass filters (50k/0.5p, 50k/0.25p)

controls.qhjzw: gates the clock into the detector

qiex8.notes: Loads the DCC sense leaf but is not in series with any clock. z3f38 ~ D*VDD, m45q ~ (1-D)*VDD; tau = 25 ns / 12.5 ns, settles within a few owbme periods. ugr2g is a dummy load (unused) balancing bgf4e/hb2uf.

vmswp.role: Pull-up replica: 5 binary-weighted ycgzf + series-R legs, unit = 1/8 of the Tx driver PU unit (1u + 2.4k vs 8u + 300 ohm)
vmswp.notes: Device m and R scale together (m=16 with 150 ohm ... m=1 with 2.4k). Rpu_rep = 8 x Rpu_driver for the same code, so calibrating against RZQ = 300 ohm sets the driver to ~37.5 ohm.

jrilr9.role: Pull-down calibration network: internal PU replica copy (calibrated code) on top of 5 binary jil3gy + R PD legs (1/8 driver unit), node mh4eq

children.role: internal copy of the calibrated pull-up

jrilr9.notes: mh4eq = VCCQ * Rpd / (Rpu + Rpd); the VCCQ/2 target makes Rpd equal the calibrated Rpu.

lyoln.role: Reference current distribution: NMOS diode on vfw3l, NMOS sink mirror for ZQ, NMOS->PMOS mirror sourcing the VREF buffer bias
lyoln.notes: ve6oy sinks current from the PMOS diode in vwt2x6; bma5 sources current into the NMOS diode of fgjco. All 1:1 (W=2u/L=1u m=2 N side, 4u/1u m=2 P side).

kwgk.role: ODT control: termination enable gated off per pin group while that group drives (rj921 & ~sjh5s, rj921 & ~i8la), VCCQ level shift, code gating, PU (active-low) and PD (active-high) gate drivers for the DQ group and the DQS/DQSB group

children.role: DQ group enable level shift -> f8urs
DQS group enable level shift -> gmbd2x
DQ PU gate drivers (m=4), i8t88i low = on
DQ PD gate drivers (m=4), ve2gc high = on

controls.sjh5s: forces DQ-group ODT off while DQ drives
controls.i8la: forces DQS-group ODT off while DQS/DQSB drive
controls.n1tu<2:0>: leg selection: ~300/150/100/75/60/50/43 ohm Thevenin for codes 1..7

kwgk.notes: LS complements i2e2, wurv and okrg<2:0> are unused. Termination auto-off avoids fighting the own driver during reads (switch-level checked against random enable/code vectors).

yqsu.role: Pi RC wire segment model of the Rx strobe RPT chain (8f-120ohm-8f)
yqsu.notes: Passive; renamed from wire_rc (Rx) to keep cell names unique.

l8ij1.role: Pi RC wire segment model of the Tx RE RPT chain (15f-200ohm-15f)
l8ij1.notes: Passive; renamed from wire_rc (Tx) to keep cell names unique.

mzrz.role: Static NAND-NAND 2:1 mux, sj7n = n7dx ? opsm : nwa8 (standard-Vt control version of kr7x)

z0nj9x.role: Driver strength code source select: ZQ calibration result (default) or register override, per bit
z0nj9x.notes: VDD-domain; outputs go to gugmik, which level-shifts them and gates with zkl7/eiu8s.

ji9j.role: Bang-bang DCC lock detector: remembers the previous comparator decision, flags a valid dither (decision change) and sets lock after two dither events

children.role: cbgn = ~ns8xwf (same edge as the code counter)
valid flag (u79k tied to vdd): ignores the first decision after reset

controls.l0zypq: clears lock state (tied to y95wm in wlyjd)

ji9j.notes: All flops on cbgn (ns8xwf falling), aligned with the fn5wjn update. qz5196 of Xtjg6/Xural (d5ewky, fskbcd) unused. Lock is sticky until l0zypq goes low.

wlyjd.role: DCC loop controller: gated update clock, RC duty detector on the distributed-clock sense leaf, StrongARM comparator, 5-bit up/down code counter, dither lock detector that freezes the code

controls.y95wm: 1 = run DCC training (detector, update clock, counter enabled); 0 = code held, lock cleared

wlyjd.notes: Closes the DCC loop through ne2krl: lze378 -> wtth -> RPT chain -> tree -> ehcfwv leaf -> qiex8 -> vui2 -> fn5wjn -> lze378. Duty > 50% -> t5n19 > op7f -> gidww=1 -> fwkdy counts gidww -> DCA PU legs shorten the high phase (negative feedback). Comparator evaluates on rz2bge rising, counter and lock detector update on rz2bge falling. After two valid dithers i7zg=1 drives hold. Comparator j1agx4 (rlip) unused. Switch-level check with a behavioural duty model: locks within +/-1 LSB from both sides and freezes. Not on the HS path (it only loads the sense leaf).

gja4.role: Rail ESD: RC-triggered clamps VCCQ-VSSQ and VDD-VSS, back-to-back diodes VSS-VSSQ

fwhwl.role: Bidirectional pad cell (DQ, DQS, DQSB): primary + secondary ESD, main PU/PD driver legs, ODT legs, pad cap

children.role: primary clamps + 200 ohm / GGNMOS secondary to xx9mog

fwhwl.notes: Two directions: sq6v18 -> xx9mog (receive, passive 200 ohm) and c2108/mita -> driver -> sq6v18 (transmit). Driver and ODT sit on the pad side of the series R; the receiver taps after it. Ctk4uyq 0.2p pad/bond cap. The same cell on DQS/DQSB keeps strobe and data pad loading equal.

ye8xk0.role: Input-only pad cell: i6p6kc (primary + secondary) and pad cap; used on RE, nRE and VREF_EXT
ye8xk0.notes: HS for the RE/nRE instances; the VREF_EXT instance (udmp/Xsuj0kt) carries a static reference. No ODT on these pads.

ne2krl.role: Read clock path: RE/nRE receiver -> in-path DCA buffer -> global RPT chain -> local clock tree (10 slice leaves, core tap, DCC sense leaf) -> core clock driver

children.role: RE/nRE receiver (diff or SE vs VREF) to VDD
clock buffer with the DCC duty adjuster
4-stage global repeater chain with wire RC
local tree: 10 slice leaves + core tap + DCC sense leaf

ne2krl.notes: Non-inverting RE -> leaves. The DCA is upstream of the repeaters and tree, so the DCC loop corrects the duty error of receiver + DCA + RPT + tree as seen at l95t3, a leaf matched to the DQS/DQSB leaves.

c4ar97.role: Per-DQ bidirectional slice: pad cell (ESD, main driver legs, ODT), Rx slice from the protected pad node (receiver, deskew, matched/unmatched select, DDR samplers, 1:4 deser), Tx slice (2:1 serializer, LS, pre-driver)

children.role: pad: ESD + driver legs + ODT legs

controls.vfk9b: Rx matched (0) / unmatched (1) path select (gusg complement)

c4ar97.notes: The pad is bidirectional: writes come in through Xal7gi gh1dv -> Xv5u7z, reads go out Xzkbs9 -> gw5es/v1v5 -> Xal7gi driver -> juby. In write mode fv9mp=0 puts all driver legs off and ODT may be on; in read mode ODT is forced off by fv9mp. h5gc66<0> is the first UI of the 4-UI word.

jq2jj.role: Per-strobe pad slice (DQS or DQSB): the same pad cell and Tx slice as a DQ bit; the protected pad node goes up to the strobe receiver

children.role: pad: ESD + driver legs + ODT legs

controls.bmsxl: even pattern (ae1v for DQS, ~ae1v for DQSB)
controls.o4wqa: odd pattern (0 for DQS, 1 for DQSB)

jq2jj.notes: Instance names Xvr2h/Xzol5aw match c4ar97 (Xv5u7z, the Rx slice, is absent: both strobe pads feed the differential strobe receiver un713b at the top). Output DQS is edge-aligned with DQ by construction (same leaf, serializer, LS, pre-driver, driver).

pk25sw.role: Control hub (static/slow): Rx enables and mode decode, driver code source select, Tx enable/code & oe gating to leg enables plus DQS patterns, ODT gating; level shifting to VCCQ where needed

children.role: Rx enables, matched/unmatched decode, SE DQS, VREF select, observe enable
Tx enables, code & oe gating, DQS/DQSB patterns
ODT enable/code with auto-off while driving

controls.e5ouu5: DQ drive enable (also ODT off for DQ)
controls.z4gmk: DQS drive enable (also ODT off for DQS)

pk25sw.notes: All inputs are VDD-domain register/command bits; outputs ending in _q and all leg/ODT gate buses are VCCQ-domain. Switch-level checked (40 random vectors): leg enables = code & oe, ODT = fwb3 & ~oe, DQS patterns, enable/mode decode.

hggq3i.role: Bias and reference block: current distribution, pre-driver slew bias, VREFQ generator/select

children.role: lgrjzh mirrors to ZQ comparators and VREF buffer
internal VREF DAC + buffer, ext/int select

hggq3i.notes: Static; nothing here is on the high-speed path. h9cgax feeds all DQ receivers, the SE strobe reference and the SE RE reference.

udmp.role: Full NAND-flash DDR (Toggle/ONFI style) byte IO: 8 bidirectional DQ slices (pad ESD + main driver + ODT, VREF receiver with matched/unmatched strobe paths, DDR samplers, 1:4 deser, 2:1 serializer + pre-driver), bidirectional DQS/DQSB pads, DQS strobe receiver/distribution and DQS/2 word clock, RE/nRE read-clock path with in-path DCA and closed DCC loop, ZQ calibration feeding the driver strength codes, VREF/bias generation, control decode, pad and rail ESD

children.role: control decode / level shift / leg-enable and ODT gating
ZQ calibration engine (PU SAR + PD tracking)
RE/nRE receiver, DCA, RPT chain, Tx clock tree
DCC detector, comparator, counter, lock detect
DQS/DQSB strobe receiver, matched trees and unmatched RPT chains
DQS/2 divider, deser clocks, bodg driver

controls.afvfm: Rx enable: DQ/DQS receivers, strobe distribution
controls.cu2af5<23:0>: per-bit Rx deskew (3 bits per DQ)
controls.fv9mp: DQ driver enable (and DQ ODT off)
controls.lxv2s: DQS/DQSB driver enable (and DQS ODT off)
controls.ww3p: driver strength from override instead of ZQ

udmp.notes: Bidirectional pads: dxmd<7:0>/a2djg/kd9h appear as inputs (write data/strobe) and outputs (read data/strobe). Two Rx paths coexist, chosen by hhqjm: matched (DQ through xbcz59, DQS through H-trees) and unmatched (DQ direct, DQS through the 9-tap repeater chain, tap n -> DQ<n>). Feedback loops: DCC (ne2krl Xzvie -> ohychn -> wlyjd Xmvda6v -> jmfj -> Xzvie), ZQ PU SAR and PD tracking inside Xdgf0zu, and the ZQ code path Xdgf0zu -> Xqxg6k -> leg enables of Xua319/Xqvsu1b/Xvemppa (open loop at run time). Unused by design: i9c6fh<8>, unig<8> (dummy leaf/tap of the complement strobe). Mwizki/Ms9a9p are MOS decaps. Not on the HS path: pk25sw, hggq3i, vwt2x6, wlyjd, gja4, texe, j19e.
